title: Make Workout Library muscle-group cards + exercises and Blog content regularly editable

requirements.text: Make Workout Library muscle-group cards editable by admins so each muscle group card can display admin-managed image and text content (e.g., cover image and description) instead of relying only on hardcoded front-end mappings.

quotes: Can u please make the library and all muscle group cards editable so I can add pics and or clips and texts for each exercise I feature in the library?

acceptanceCriteria: An admin can update each muscle group’s display content (at minimum: image URL and description text) from an admin/creator UI.
WorkoutLibraryPage muscle-group cards render the admin-managed image/description when present; if missing, they fall back to the current default images/labels.
Non-admin users cannot edit muscle-group card content.
Changes persist across refreshes and deployments (uses existing canister state).

requirements.text: Update the Workout Library editing flow so admins can add/update per-exercise media and text content in a practical way for regular updates, including support for externally hosted image/video URLs (not only /assets/* paths).

quotes: ...so I can add pics and or clips and texts for each exercise I feature in the library?

acceptanceCriteria: ExerciseManagement allows saving exercises with either site asset paths (e.g., /assets/...) or external URLs (e.g., https://...) for imageUrl and videoUrl.
ExerciseManagement continues to validate required fields (name, cues, imageUrl, videoUrl), but does not block regular updates by requiring /assets/ URLs.
Workout Library exercise preview cards continue to display each exercise’s imageUrl (with a sensible fallback if missing/unreachable).

requirements.text: Ensure the Blog section is clearly editable by admins for regularly adding and updating articles, using the existing blog management workflow (create/edit/publish/unpublish/delete) and making it easy to find from the Blog area.

quotes: Same goes for the Blog section.  I need to be able to add articles  for my blogs. Make both sections editable to update regularly.

acceptanceCriteria: An admin can create, edit, publish/unpublish, and delete blog posts from the Creator Dashboard using the existing BlogManagement UI.
From the public Blog page, admins have a clear navigation path to the blog editing area (e.g., a visible “Manage Blog” button/link for admins only).
Non-admin users do not see admin-only blog editing navigation or controls.

constraints: Respect the existing single-actor backend architecture (all Motoko logic in backend/main.mo).
Do not edit files under frontend immutable paths (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui).
Use English for any user-facing text.
Do not introduce any email functionality.
nonGoals: Adding new authentication methods beyond Internet Identity.
Implementing real-time collaboration or live editing.
Building a rich-text editor or media transcoding pipeline (plain text + URL-based media is sufficient unless separately requested).
